caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a standing figure representing a Native American man. He is standing on a rectangular, tiered wooden pedestal with one leg raised and resting on a smaller block above the base. The figure is dressed in a knee-length, red tunic with blue trim at the neckline and sleeves, and a green belt and sash with leaf-like decorations hanging from the waist. He is wearing cream-colored leggings with vertical brown stripes and brown moccasin-like shoes. Around his neck, he has a blue necklace with a large yellow pendant. On his head is a headdress consisting of a yellow band and a series of feathers in red, green, and blue colors, arranged upright. His left arm is bent upward, holding a bundle of green leaves, while his right arm is bent and held at his side. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Cigar Store Indian
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
